reason_aliases.meaning: artifact/readback round epoch < current round admission epoch

axes.rule: UNKNOWN lives only on the conclusion axis. Our old verdict UNKNOWN maps to verdict=UNVERIFIABLE + evidence_status=ABSENT + conclusion=UNKNOWN. FAIL maps to REJECT.

two_gate_note: A row can exercise two independent gates (anchor valid AND round fresh). STALE_ARTIFACT_ROUND has a valid counterparty_nonce anchor; only the round comparison catches it. A judge that checks anchors only scores it PASS.
